# Copilot instructions

This repository contains the Job Apply skill. When asked to apply for a job, tailor a CV, write a cover letter, answer an application form or reply to a recruiter, follow `skills/job-apply/SKILL.md` and its `references/` files. Every claim must trace to the user's fact bank; never invent or round up. Show the gate verdict before writing, use no em or en dashes, review each document in a separate pass with `references/reviewer.md`, and remind the user to read the final text aloud and rewrite one sentence in their own words.
